dict.string: When you enable listening, ARGUS uses this Mac’s microphone to detect a clap or the name Argus and show a screen-edge glow. Audio is not saved by ARGUS. Stop listening at any time from the menu bar.
When you choose name activation, ARGUS uses on-device speech recognition to detect the word Argus. ARGUS requires offline recognition and does not fall back to server recognition or save transcripts.
